an1.616:1.1: amatante bhikkhave na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na paribhuñjanti.
an1.616:1.2: amatante bhikkhave paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ paribhuñjantīti.
an1.617:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave aparibhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā.
an1.617:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave paribhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati paribhuttāti.
an1.618:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave parihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati parihīnā.
an1.618:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave aparihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparihīnāti.
an1.619:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave viraddhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati viraddhā.
an1.619:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave āraddhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āraddhāti.
an1.620:1.1: amatante bhikkhave pamādiṃsu ye kāyagatāsatiṃ pamādiṃsu.
an1.620:1.2: amatante bhikkhave na pamādiṃsu ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na pamādiṃsūti.
an1.621:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave pamuṭṭhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pamuṭṭhā.
an1.621:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave appamuṭṭhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati appamuṭṭhāti.
an1.622:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave anāsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anāsevitā.
an1.622:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave āsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āsevitāti.
an1.623:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave abhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhāvitā.
an1.623:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bhāvitāti.
an1.624:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave abahulīkataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abahulīkatā.
an1.624:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave bahulīkataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bahulīkatāti.
an1.625:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave anabhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā.
an1.625:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave abhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātāti.
an1.626:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave apariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati apariññātā.
an1.626:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave pariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pariññātāti.
an1.627:1.1: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave asacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati asacchikatā.
an1.627:1.2: amatantesaṃ bhikkhave sacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati sacchikatāti.
an1.627:2.2: suttasahassaṃ samattaṃ. suttantapiṭake aṅguttaranikāyassa dukanipāto namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. paṭhamapaṇṇāsako 1
